title: 3.10 My, Your, His, and Her
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Use my, your, his and her before names and known objects with clear ownership and speaker perspective.
grammar_function: Possessive adjective + noun: my/your/his/her name or object.
prerequisite: 3.1 fixed name chunks, 3.2 speaker perspective and Unit 2 objects and this/that.
speaking_outcome: Say whose name or thing it is with my, your, his and her.
